Package com.jasonwjones.pbcs.aif

package com.jasonwjones.pbcs.aif
Maps the request/response payloads for the unofficial, admin-gated AIF REST endpoint historically used to discover application and dimension metadata before PBCS/EPM Cloud exposed an official API for it (see PlanTypeDimension for the modern replacement). Internal implementation package of simple POJOs with no behavior; not part of the public API.

  • Classes
    Class
    Description
    AifApplication
    Maps the application details returned by the unofficial data management (DM/AIF) "applications" endpoint, including the up to six plan names an application can have, which of those plans each dimension is valid for, and any additional application properties.
    AifAppProperty
    Maps a single application property as returned alongside application details by the unofficial data management (DM/AIF) "applications" endpoint.
    AifDimension
    Maps a single dimension entry as returned by the unofficial data management (DM/AIF) "applications" endpoint, describing the dimension's name, its balance column name, its class, and which of an application's up to six plans the dimension is valid for.
